_readme: Single source of truth for every story card on the site.
That rewrites the marked regions in index.html (the whole story catalogue,
nav items and structured data) and the generated block in sitemap.xml.
adventures.html / treks.html / mountaineering.html only redirect to index.html.
ADD A STORY: append to 'stories'. 'category' and 'sub' must match ids below.
name      short name used in footers and structured data
date      YYYY-MM  (lists sort newest first; the newest is the Latest Story by default)
latest    optional true on ONE story to pin it as the Latest Story, first in every list
theme     snow | green | sky | kuari | ember   (card colours live in site.css)
days      number, or null if unknown
image     srcset is optional; position is an optional object-position
ADD A CATEGORY / SUB: add to 'categories'. 'soon' is the Coming Soon card text;
a sub may carry 'link': { href, label } shown beside its title.

stories.name: NIM Basic Mountaineering Course
stories.title: The Mountain Doesn't Differentiate
stories.desc: The mountain doesn't care who you are. It just asks what you're made of. Basic Mountaineering Course, BMC 293 Ladies Batch, NIM Uttarkashi.
stories.featured_desc: The mountain doesn't care who you are. It just asks what you're made of. Twenty-eight days of rope, ice and snow — the Basic Mountaineering Course, BMC 293 Ladies Batch, NIM Uttarkashi.

stories.name: Pangarchula Peak
stories.title: The Sky at Your Feet
stories.desc: A peak that demands everything and returns it tenfold. Pangarchula isn't just a climb — it's a reckoning. The kind that leaves you quieter, and somehow fuller, on the other side.

stories.name: Kuari Pass
stories.title: Where the Himalayas Open Up
stories.desc: The Curzon Trail. Nanda Devi. Dronagiri. Kamet. The Kuari Pass offers a panorama so vast it feels less like a view and more like a conversation with the sky itself.

stories.name: Buranghati Trek
stories.title: Getting Lost to Find Myself
stories.desc: The trail began before dawn. The forest swallowed the path whole and I walked into a silence so complete it felt like a second skin — unfamiliar at first, and then, somehow, like coming home.

stories.name: Kedarkantha Peak
stories.title: The Unfinished Business
stories.desc: The mountain has been calling for a while now. Snow-covered meadows, frozen lakes, a summit that promises a sky unlike any other — some journeys begin long before the first step.

stories.name: Kudremukha Peak
stories.title: The Mountain With a Horse's Face
stories.desc: A mountain wearing a horse's face, twenty kilometres of forest and grass and water, and rain that doesn't ask permission.

stories.name: Bandaje Falls
stories.title: Where the Water Starts
stories.desc: Not a peak. Not a summit. Just a waterfall that makes you feel like you've found the end of the world.

stories.name: Kodachadri
stories.title: Where the Mist Lives
stories.desc: The mountain wakes you before you're ready. Mist in the trees, rain on the path, cold red mud that claims your shoes like it always meant to.

stories.name: Netravathi Peak
stories.title: Where the River Is Born
stories.desc: Where a river is born in the mist, and the grasslands feel like a world that shouldn't exist.
